match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT ELEVATOR — MORNING. morning. Natural lighting appropriate to morning. #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save, Clean and bright with true-to-life color. Whites are crisp, skin tones warm and natural. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

Image 2 pockets the lipstick and steps out as the doors open.. Carry the movement naturally from the shared glance into the lobby.. Camera: brisk follow

overall_soundscape: Elevator doors slide open; lobby bustle rises. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

detailed_description:
The video is filmed in a modern, social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is bright morning natural light with crisp whites, warm skin tones, and lifted shadows. The color palette consists of #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, and #E8F4E8. 

[Shot 1] The shot begins as the keyframe from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> stand inside a modern elevator with white tiled walls and a large mirror. <Subject 1> looks at <Subject 2> with a shared glance while holding <Subject 3> near her face, having just applied the coral lipstick. <Subject 2> returns the gaze with a subtle, natural smile. The camera is static, capturing the intimate moment and the detailed finish of the lipstick.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a brisk follow shot as the elevator doors slide open, revealing a sunlit downtown lobby. <Subject 1> naturally pockets <Subject 3> into her blazer pocket and steps out of the elevator with fluid movement. The camera tracks her at a medium speed as she transitions from the elevator into the lobby area. The background shows blurred figures of people and modern architecture. The atmosphere is airy and high-end, emphasizing the aesthetic.

overall_soundscape:
The mechanical whir of elevator doors sliding open, followed by the rising ambient bustle of a city lobby including footsteps and distant chatter.
